title: haworthia retusa var. mutica

This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including the ability to lower blood pressure, improve sleep quality, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. Haworthia retusa var. mutica is also believed to possess therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may contribute to its traditional use in folk medicine.
